heroHeadline: Rohan Marina One — Palatial Oceanfront Sky Suites on NITK Beach Road, Surathkal
heroSubtitle: An iconic 8.28-acre oceanfront landmark rising up to 46 storeys. Featuring 433 all-sea-facing residences, a 50,000 sq.ft. beachfront club, and a managed 5-star hospitality rental model delivering 8%–11% net yields.
editorialStory:
Redefining India’s coastal skyline, Rohan Marina One rises majestically as a dual-tower icon along the golden shores of Surathkal, Mangaluru. Soaring up to 46 storeys, this 8.28-acre oceanfront masterwork is engineered so that every single residence commands an uninterrupted, 180-degree panorama of the Arabian Sea.

Blending private residential luxury with world-class hospitality, residents enjoy exclusive access to an Olympic-size horizon pool, a 50,000 sq.ft. wellness club, rooftop sky lounges, and a managed hospitality-linked rental model in 'The Resort' tower—perfect for global NRI investors and high-net-worth professionals.

Built by Rohan Corporation, a premier real estate leader with over 30 years of impeccable delivery across coastal Karnataka, Marina One offers absolute statutory transparency backed by Karnataka RERA registration PRM/KA/RERA/1257/334/PR/180625/007850 and milestone-linked escrow safety.

faqs.question: What is the exact location and Karnataka RERA registration for Rohan Marina One?
faqs.answer: Rohan Marina One is located directly on NITK Beach Road in Surathkal, Mangaluru 575014. It is fully approved by Karnataka RERA under registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1257/334/PR/180625/007850.

faqs.question: Do all residences have views of the Arabian Sea?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rohan Marina One is architecturally master-planned as an all-sea-facing coastal enclave where 100% of residences command an unobstructed 180-degree panorama of the Arabian Sea.

faqs.question: What is the hospitality-linked ownership model in The Resort tower?
faqs.answer: Block B (The Resort) offers an optional 5-star managed hospitality leaseback program, generating 8%–11% projected annual net rental yields for homeowners when not in personal use.

faqs.question: What are the payment milestones and bank approvals?
faqs.answer: The project features a transparent 10:80:10 construction-linked payment structure with pre-approvals from leading mortgage lenders including SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, and Bank of Baroda.
